create_interactive_document_with_tools: create an InteractiveDocumentWithTools instance with a language model and registered tools for LLM tool calling
open_question_with_tool_calls: ask an open question where the LLM can invoke registered tools to gather information before answering
multiple_choice_question_with_tools: present a multiple choice question allowing the LLM to use tools before selecting an answer
parse_tool_call_from_llm_output: parse a JSON tool call from LLM output supporting multi-tool and single-tool shorthand formats
execute_tool_by_name: execute a registered tool by name with given arguments and return the truncated result
